summaryZh: Toomey Lab 研究早中期年龄相关性黄斑变性中的糖生物学与脂蛋白代谢。重点是 Bruch 膜糖胺聚糖随衰老的变化及其对疾病发展的作用。
researchQuestions: Bruch 膜糖胺聚糖随衰老的变化，在早期和中期年龄相关性黄斑变性的发生中发挥什么作用？

evidence.quote: Toomey Lab Pharmacological Potential of Glycosaminoglycans
a laboratory research program focused on glycobiology and lipoprotein metabolism in early and intermediate stages of age-related macular degeneration (AMD).
our lab is focused on understanding the role of Bruch’s membrane glycosaminoglycan changes with aging and the development of early and intermediate AMD.
Assistant Professor of Clinical Ophthalmology at UC San Diego, Shiley Eye Institute

Through collaborations with the world-renowned UC, San Diego Glycobiology Research and Training Center, our lab is focused on understanding the role of Bruch’s membrane glycosaminoglycan changes with aging and the development of early and intermediate AMD.
